              Judicial ・ criminal psychology is a learning discipline that studies and practices the use of psychological knowledge and techniques in judicial proceedings related to crimes. Students will learn the roles of psychological professionals in this field and the way psychology should be used by grasping the laws and systems of criminal and juvenile justice and understanding the work and cooperation of related institutions and facilities.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The lecture will focus on the laws and systems of criminal and juvenile justice, and the work of related institutions and facilities. The lecture will be while introducing the atmosphere of the field based on my experience working at the Family Court.
